sentences.en: His restlessness gave her a hint that something was wrong.
sentences.zh: 他坐立不安的样子让她觉得事情可能不对劲。

sentences.en: The pilot hinted that it might be a UFO.
sentences.zh: 飞行员暗示那可能是不明飞行物。

sentences.en: The speaker hinted at corruption in the political world.
sentences.zh: 演讲者提到了政治界可能存在腐败问题。

senses.zh: 暗示，提示，示意，建议，小部分
